summary: Five of six seats returned schema-valid reviews of plan r2 (claude, codex, gemini, kimi, glm); gemini approved with no concern and the other four asked for revision. Qwen exited nonzero after its 600 s wall-time budget, so it contributes no opinion. Five groups are rated high: the GO1 cache key, the preview of a refused candidate, whole-proposal refusals, the GO2 version move, and GO5's empty round. Three more reach two or three supporters; five concerns have one supporter each.

agreed_concerns.title: GO1 cache key must keep the strict .json reader distinct
agreed_concerns.summary: Keyed by content alone (R0.5) or by a reader test restated as ".json or starts with {", a parse that succeeded through the YAML fallback could be returned to a .json caller that must refuse it. The parse depends on the bytes and on whether the source suffix is .json.

agreed_concerns.title: GO2 promises a preview for a candidate that does not validate, which the preview model cannot hold
agreed_concerns.summary: EvolutionPreview requires validation evidence, verbalization and blast radius built from a validated candidate; a refused candidate raises before any preview exists. The plan does not say what document carries outcomes of a refused proposal or what apply does with it.

agreed_concerns.title: Whole-proposal refusals (D-12, validation) cannot yield per-operation verdicts, and one pass cannot establish admitted
agreed_concerns.summary: D-12 messages name no element and stop at the first fault; layer-1 issues stop layer 2. Under D1 (a) refused-by-d12 is unreachable per operation, and admitted after one pass may hide a masked fault.

agreed_concerns.title: GO2-C3 and R0.3 cannot hold if the preview schema version moves
agreed_concerns.summary: The preview version must equal the proposal version, so moving it moves the proposal version and every proposal and preview digest. The omit-when-unset optional-field precedent adds a field without a version move.

agreed_concerns.title: GO5-C2 cannot be met from a proposal and its preview: an empty round has no proposal
agreed_concerns.summary: A round that proposes nothing has no proposal or preview, and a reused element leaves no operation, so the stated inputs cannot tell the two rounds apart.

agreed_concerns.title: Narrowing alone does not make the original preview stale
agreed_concerns.summary: Narrowing writes no model bytes; only applying the narrowed proposal makes the original preview a stale model CAS.

agreed_concerns.title: Start conditions disagree with the one-writer order
agreed_concerns.summary: "merged or not started" and "GO4 at any point" contradict the order VG1, GO1, VG2-VG5, GO2-GO5; GO5 edits unattended-growth.md without the VG5 condition.

agreed_concerns.title: GO1-C5 timed ratio sits in the required lane
agreed_concerns.summary: The ratio depends on machine load; parse counts and byte equality should be the required gates and the ratio a recorded measurement.

prioritized_fixes.title: GO1 cache key must keep the strict .json reader distinct
prioritized_fixes.action: Amend R0.5, section 2 GO1 and section 6: key = (sha256 of bytes, source suffix is .json); one helper computes it for the parser and the key. Add a case: YAML flow bytes starting with { parsed as .yaml then requested as .json are refused.

prioritized_fixes.title: GO2 promises a preview for a candidate that does not validate, which the preview model cannot hold
prioritized_fixes.action: Add to section 2 GO2 and D1: outcomes for a refused candidate live in a refusal report separate from EvolutionPreview, which apply cannot take; criterion: apply refuses it. Carry its shape into the GO2 spec.

prioritized_fixes.title: Whole-proposal refusals (D-12, validation) cannot yield per-operation verdicts, and one pass cannot establish admitted
prioritized_fixes.action: Restate D1 (a): a refusal names an operation only where the gate can locate it; the gate collects every fault it can locate; otherwise the outcome is a whole-proposal refusal with operations unassessed. Define admitted as no refusal found and require a re-preview of the narrowed proposal; add a two-fault fixture.

prioritized_fixes.title: GO2-C3 and R0.3 cannot hold if the preview schema version moves
prioritized_fixes.action: Change D2 (a): operation_outcomes is an omit-when-unset optional preview field with no schema version move. Restate R0.3 and GO2-C3: a proposal admitted today with no outcomes requested keeps every byte and digest.

prioritized_fixes.title: GO5-C2 cannot be met from a proposal and its preview: an empty round has no proposal
prioritized_fixes.action: Define the GO5 summary input as the host round file (reply ids reused, host drops) plus the proposal and preview when one exists; define the summary of a round with no proposal; build GO5-C2 fixtures differing only there.

prioritized_fixes.title: Narrowing alone does not make the original preview stale
prioritized_fixes.action: Split GO3-C3: before the narrowed proposal is applied, the original preview still applies whole or is refused by revalidation as today; after it is applied, the original preview is refused as a stale model CAS.

prioritized_fixes.title: Start conditions disagree with the one-writer order
prioritized_fixes.action: Replace "merged or not started" with "merged on main" for VG2/VG4 (GO2, GO3) and VG2/VG5 (GO4, GO5); GO4 after its ruling and that condition; add the coordinator handshake.

prioritized_fixes.title: GO1-C5 timed ratio sits in the required lane
prioritized_fixes.action: Move GO1-C5 to a recorded measurement (marker excluded from the focused lane) beside C6; C1-C4 stay the required gates.

prioritized_fixes.title: go1-canonical-date
prioritized_fixes.action: T3 compares a type-preserving snapshot (the round-trip YAML dump or a deep structural equality) rather than canonical JSON, demonstrated on the YAML date case.

prioritized_fixes.title: go2-c1-exit-3-unverified
prioritized_fixes.action: Read the exit of each whole-proposal refusal now; word GO2-C1 as the exit today's refusal gives.

prioritized_fixes.title: go2-lane-omits-preview-consumers
prioritized_fixes.action: Add tests/test_evolve_source_document.py, tests/test_evolve_population_check.py and tests/test_evolve_shape_matches.py to the GO2 lane.

prioritized_fixes.title: h21-d6-shared-file-claim-incomplete
prioritized_fixes.action: Say GO1 and VG1 share only the append-only homes docs/release-notes.md and dev/components/; name tests/test_unattended_growth_guidance.py among the shared files.

prioritized_fixes.title: h20-wording-contradicts-r03-d2
prioritized_fixes.action: Gloss H20 to R0.2: no check weakened or removed and no existing refusal's exit moves.
